Metadata.metaTitle: GLADIUS - Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu School in Tbilisi
Metadata.metaDescription: GLADIUS is a martial arts school in Tbilisi, Georgia specializing in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Krav Maga, and MMA for all ages and skill levels.

Classes.title: Our Classes
Classes.bjjKidsDesc: Gladius Club is the central Tbilisi club of the Georgian National Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Federation, where a special unified development program has been created for children.
Classes.bjjAdultsDesc: Gi is the traditional form of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, focused on technical precision, positional control, and strategic thinking. No-Gi is a fast-paced and dynamic style that closely reflects real-life conditions.

PromoSections.promoDescFree:
Do you want to try a new sport and feel the true fighting spirit?
The “Gladius” club offers you the opportunity to attend one completely free trial training session.

Come and challenge yourself, experience an energetic and friendly sports environment, meet our professional trainers, and see how the training process works.
This is the best way to discover for yourself how interesting, dynamic, and beneficial this activity can be for you.

Come once — and decide for yourself whether “Gladius” is your place. 💪
PromoSections.promoDescIndividual:
The “Gladius” club offers personal training sessions for all ages — children, teenagers, and adults.
An individual approach, full attention from the trainer, and faster progress.

Work on yourself more effectively — with personal training at “Gladius.” 💪 

 We offer personalized training programs for both adults and children:
🥋 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

PromoSections.promoDescSchedule: Classes are held 5 days a week, with the possibility of choosing the time and day of classes. We are always happy to see you at training!
PromoSections.promoDescMasterClasses: We regularly host seminars and open lessons with experienced trainers and athletes. Stay tuned for updates!

Masterclass.title: Masterclass
Masterclass.description:
🥊 Krav Maga Masterclasses (Self-Defense)
I conduct practical Krav Maga masterclasses for various organizations, companies, and security services. The programs are designed around real-life threats and focus on improving employee safety and preparedness.

Masterclasses are suitable for:
• Corporate organizations
• Security and protection services
• Educational and specialized programs

The program includes:
• Responses to real-life attacks
• Defense against armed and unarmed attackers
• Effective actions under stress
• Team coordination and situational awareness

Benefits for the organizer:
• Improved employee safety
• A practical and professional training program
• Increased team motivation and responsibility

Results for employees:
• Increased self-confidence
• Ability to react effectively in critical situations
• Improved stress management
• Practical skills applicable in daily life

🥋 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Masterclasses
I conduct Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu masterclasses for organizations focused on the physical and mental development of their teams. The program is based on control, balance, and strategic thinking.

Ideal for:
• Corporate teams
• Security and special services
• Sports and educational projects

The program includes:
• Body control and safe grappling techniques
• Efficient use of strength
• Development of focus and discipline
• Teamwork skills

Benefits for the organizer:
• Increased physical and mental resilience of employees
• Stronger team cohesion
• A unique and non-standard training format

Results for employees:
• Better body control
• Reduced stress levels
• Improved concentration
• Enhanced physical fitness and mental toughness

About.aboutDescription: GLADIUS is a martial arts school located in Tbilisi, Georgia. We specialize in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Krav Maga, and MMA. Our experienced coaches are dedicated to providing high-quality training for all levels, from beginners to advanced practitioners. We believe in creating a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone can learn and grow.

Coaches.title: Our Coaches
Coaches.coach1Role: Founder & Head Coach – Club Gladius | Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Black Belt (IV Dan) | World Champion
Coaches.coach1Description: Giorgi Oboladze is one of the pioneers of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and a key figure in the development of this sport. He was the first to start the systematic development of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in Georgia and opened a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in 2014. He is the President of the National Federation of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu of Georgia (since 2023) and the founder of the Georgia Jiu-Jitsu Tour (2022) — a platform that has played a significant role in establishing a competitive professional Jiu-Jitsu environment in Georgia. In 2014, Giorgi Oboladze founded Club Gladius, which today is one of the leading martial arts academies in Georgia. As the head coach, he creates a high-level system of technical, physical, and mental training based on discipline, strategy, and continuous development. Giorgi Oboladze holds a Jiu-Jitsu Black Belt — IV Dan and is a World Champion and winner of many other international tournaments (Japanese Jiu-Jitsu), as well as a professional Krav Maga instructor with many years of experience in special physical training and tactical professional exercises. In parallel with his sports activities, he is the Chief Specialist for Construction, Standardization, and Occupational Safety at SOCAR Georgia Gas nationwide. Giorgi Oboladze holds a higher education degree and is a doctoral candidate. His work combines sports achievements, instructorship, and strategic leadership, making him one of the most prominent figures in martial arts in Georgia.
